entities.name: Jože Brilej
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jože Brilej was a Yugoslav jurist, politician, diplomat, Communist revolutionary, and close associate of Josip Broz Tito. During his diplomatic career, he was the ambassador of Yugoslavia to the United Kingdom (1950–1952), head of the Yugoslav mission to the United Nations (1954–1958), and ambassador to Egypt.
